entities.summary: Roman Republic, a political institution in Italy during The Roman Republic (146 BCE–27 BCE). Grew from Assassination of Julius Caesar on the Ides of March (44 BC) and Julius Caesar crosses the Rubicon, igniting civil war (49 BC). Led to the emergence of Octavian's victory at Act and Gracchi.
